en: Hi there! I'm Phoebe of the Elite Four. I trained at the top of Mt. Pyre, among the spirits who rest there.
Up there, I learned to share my heart with Ghost-type Pokémon. We understand each other completely.
Let's see if your bond with your Pokémon can match ours!
Oh... we lost. Your bond with your Pokémon must run very deep.
Go on to the next room. I'll be cheering for you, quietly, the way the spirits do.
The way on is open. Keep that bond strong, and you'll go far.
